review_output.summary: [Medium] new mp_rand_in_range32() has no test for its bounds or edge ranges
review_output.failure_scenario: Impact: no test covers range==1 (mask 0), exact power-of-two, non-power-of-two (rejection loop), range > 2^31 (relies on mp_round_next_power_of_2 returning 0 and the mask wrapping to UINT32_MAX), or min > 0. playlist_shuffle uses the result directly as an index into pl->entries, so a future off-by-one in the mask or offset would read out of bounds undetected. Remedy: add test/random.c linked with test_utils (misc/random.c is already in test_utils_files). With a fixed seed, loop over (0,1), (5,6), (0,8), (3,11), (0,7), (0,UINT32_MAX), (UINT32_MAX-1,UINT32_MAX) asserting min <= r < max, and bucket-count a small range to check every value appears.

review_output.summary: [Medium] PRNG refactor to caller-held state has no fixed-seed test for the seeded path
review_output.failure_scenario: Impact: with a nonzero seed, mp_rand_seed/mp_rand_next are deterministic but nothing pins their output. A mistake in moving the state (wrong index, missing update) would still produce random-looking numbers and go unnoticed, and the [0,1) range of mp_rand_next_double is unchecked. Remedy: add tests asserting the same seed gives identical sequences, different seeds differ, the first few outputs for a fixed seed are pinned, and 0.0 <= d < 1.0 over many draws. Guard seed-dependent checks with #ifndef FUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION, since that build forces the seed to 42.

review_output.summary: [Low] mp_rand_next_double() has no callers left and should be deleted
review_output.failure_scenario: Impact: its only caller (playlist shuffle) now uses mp_rand_in_range32(), yet the function was rewritten and kept in the public header. It is unused code that still has to be maintained, and it uses the slightly biased float-scaling approach this change moved away from, which invites the next caller to pick it over the unbiased helper. Remedy: remove mp_rand_next_double() from misc/random.h and misc/random.c; add it back only when a real caller needs a double.

review_output.summary: [Low] Unused include of misc/random.h left after the mp_rand_seed(0) call was removed
review_output.failure_scenario: Impact: the change removes the only use of the random module in player/main.c, so the include points to a dependency that no longer exists and misleads anyone looking for where global PRNG seeding happens (osdep/io.c has the same unused include, but it predates this change). Remedy: remove #include "misc/random.h" from player/main.c, and optionally from osdep/io.c in a separate cleanup.
